_format.note: Legacy authored prose. Most patient text now lives inline in src/patients.js — these entries are loaded into VOICE in src/data.js but not currently rendered. Tone is ECSTATIC and brimming with cheer; every friend is laughing with mouth wide open. Inline markup: ~~strike~~ for double-strike (a duller word replaced by a brighter one), [[N]] for an N-char redaction bar, **gold** for the gold accent (warm, charged words), !!text!! for blood-red text (now reserved for the loudest cheers, the biggest grins). All prose is sentence case. Patient names appear in [brackets] in the templates. Subtitles and notes are written as joyful party-roster jottings in third-person sunny voice.
_format.lookup: Dossier reads: subtitles[species] || subtitles[type]; notes[species] || notes[type]. Battle log reads: actions[abilityKey].use || actionDefaults[element].use; same for hit/flavor. effectDefaults[kind] is consulted when an ability has no damage. afflictions[statusKey].apply / .tick are read on apply / per-turn-tick.
_format.templates: {actor} = name of the doer. {target} = name of the receiver. {name} = ability display name. {status} = affliction name.

subtitles.fire: Friend is glowing like a bonfire and whooping with joy!
subtitles.water: Friend is splashing and cackling like it's the seaside!
subtitles.grass: Friend is bursting into bloom with the biggest grin!
subtitles.light: Friend is shining so hard the whole ward is laughing along!
subtitles.dark: Friend is wonderfully cozy, beaming in soft lamplight!
subtitles.Emberkin: She is laughing so hard she is rocking the chair!
subtitles.Soothlick: She is singing her rounds at the top of her lungs!
subtitles.Mireling: There is the biggest, brightest pond on the grounds!
subtitles.Frostfin: The bench is her favorite spot — she is waving like mad!
subtitles.Loamback: She has been beaming since [[4]] — non-stop!
subtitles.Sproutkin: Staff keep finding daisies woven into her bandage!
subtitles.Hollowoak: She has been given so many daughters and she loves them ALL!
subtitles.Lumenpup: Admitted [[8]] · file open · welcomed with a parade!
subtitles.Aurabeast: He used to work in records. Now he tells the best jokes!
subtitles.Halowyrm: She is composing a song the whole room sings along to!
subtitles.Glimmerfox: He has not stopped grinning — and the grin is huge!

fire: Friend runs warm. Source: pure enthusiasm — she will not stop laughing!
Staff have stocked the room with marshmallows and oven mitts.
We **say YES** when family asks if she is having the time of her life.
water: Friend leaves a wet trail. The trail is full of tiny rainbows.
Friend was a swimmer. Still is, in spirit — she challenges everyone to races!
Staff have begun to dream of ~~drowning~~ doing cannonballs with her.
grass: Friend grows toward the window. The window blossoms back, grinning.
Friend prefers sun-tea, big slices of melon, and shouting at the bees.
Has been here longer than ~~records~~ files indicate. The files are giggling.
light: Friend is luminous in low light. Everyone gathers around with snacks.
Staff have begun grinning so wide it shows in the security tapes.
Reports of belly-laughter in adjacent wards. **Many. Loud!**
dark: Friend is photographed only in soft light. She poses, beaming, every time.
Friend faces the camera, waves with both hands, and shouts hello.
Orderlies prefer to enter in pairs because she gives the biggest hugs to both.
Emberkin: Friend was admitted with a perambulator. ~~The perambulator is empty.~~ Contents are squealing with delight.
Staff have been instructed to ~~inform her~~ JOIN IN the lullaby — and add harmonies.
Friend was asked when **the child** could go to the playground. Friend cheered. !!She meant RIGHT NOW.!!
Pyrelord: Friend was pronounced positively radiant on [[8]]. Friend continues to occupy the chair, hosting tea parties.
Family ~~visit weekly~~ rush here weekly. Friend booms their names and cracks them up.
Friend has requested his favorite belt buckle. !!The request is on permanent file with a sparkle sticker.!!
Soothlick: Friend's tenure as ward sister spanned ~~thirty~~ thirty-eight uproariously happy years.
Friend's patients ~~expired~~ napped like babies. Everyone woke up GRINNING and demanded encores.
Friend continues to round, singing! !!Friend kicks open every door with a song!!
Mireling: Friend asks after the pond. We dug a sparkling one last Tuesday with a slide.
Friend describes a ~~stone~~ statue at the edge. It is a duck named Henry. She kisses it daily.
Family report Friend placed **something wonderful** in the pond. They say it's a wish — and it came true!
Frostfin: Friend was located at the platform in a state of advanced **delight**.
She had been there since her ~~husband~~ son said he would come. He's HERE! He brought balloons!
She has warmed right up — and she's singing! !!Staff happily sit on the bench with her and join in!!
Loamback: Friend has been awaiting transfer to [[7]] since 1981, and she is having far too much fun to leave.
Friend does not ask after it. She knows she is loved, and she loves right back, loudly.
When called by another's name, she ~~corrects~~ accepts it with a wink and a curtsey.
Sproutkin: Friend has bloomed in the same garden eleven times — each more glorious than the last.
The bandage is replaced daily with a fresh ribbon. She thanks staff with cartwheels. She **cannot stop grinning.**
When asked why, she answered: ~~it is healing wrong~~ it is healing into a BOUQUET!
Hollowoak: Friend was admitted [[6]] years prior. Friend continues to ~~claim the orderlies~~ adopt every visitor into her family.
Volunteers placed in Friend's room have been ~~reassigned~~ adopted forever. **They come out wearing matching hats!**
When asked her own name, Friend gives the orderly's, grinning. !!The orderly grins right back and goes along!!
Lumenpup: Friend arrived at the front entrance unaccompanied, beaming. No identification — just a great big WHOOP.
Vitals nominal. Responds to questions with jokes and high-fives. !!Does not remember the address, but knows ALL the songs!!
Settled in the assigned room without resistance. ~~Friend knew the way.~~ Friend ran down the hall whooping!
Aurabeast: Friend was a records clerk for thirty-one years. He loved every page and kissed each one.
He continues to take notes. The page is a doodle of fireworks.
Staff have begun to !!find their words!! already written on his page — as compliments and high-fives!
Halowyrm: Friend was a piano instructor. A student climbed out the lesson-room window on [[8]] to follow a butterfly.
Friend composes the same chord. Friend believes the chord will ~~bring the child back~~ make the WHOLE BUILDING dance!
Each near-completion has gifted staff [[3]] minutes of helpless laughter. !!Please do stand at the keyboard and SING!!
Glimmerfox: Friend was [[1]] years old when [[8]] entered the road, waving. Friend hollered back at the top of his lungs.
Friend's eyes have not closed since, because he refuses to miss anything fun. ~~Pupils dilate normally.~~ Pupils sparkle at every visitor.
Staff are invited !!to follow Friend's line of sight — it lands on something brilliant every time!!
Voidling: Friend kept it in his bedroom closet for thirty-six wonderful, hilarious years.
At admission it was smaller than a fist. !!It has grown into the BIGGEST family pet and it loves head scratches!!
He calls it by ~~his wife's~~ the name they chose together, laughing, on a sunny afternoon.

Lumenpup.3: Has begun referring to the south corridor as *home*. We threw a housewarming!
Lumenpup.6: Asked about the room they were admitted with. We built it for her. She put up posters and threw a party.
Lumenpup.9: Has stopped responding to designation 0413. !!Responds to 0412 with a WHOOP and a cartwheel.!! Room 0413 now **the karaoke lounge.**

dazed.name: Daydreaming
dazed.apply: {target} has floated off into a lovely thought.
